title: DocumentationRequest
description: Parameters for profile.previewDocumentation: which repository's profile to render into documentation, and where the files would go if the user later chose to export them. Rendering is deterministic and costs nothing, so a preview can be asked for as often as the user likes.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute path of the worktree root whose profile is being rendered.

target.description: Where the files would be written on export. This affects the preview because it decides the file paths and therefore which of them already exist.
